headline: Indian IT services posted mixed revenue growth with AI as a key driver.
summary: Revenue growth ranged from low single digits to over 50% YoY. AI‑related revenue and deal wins were highlighted by several firms. Guidance was trimmed by Infosys but raised by Coforge and Mphasis. Profit growth was uneven, with Wipro seeing a decline.

themes.title: AI‑driven services
themes.detail: AI revenue grew strongly, supporting top‑line and profit in multiple firms.

leaders.why: Revenue surged 53.6% YoY and EBIT margin guidance raised to 16%.

laggards.why: Revenue grew 9.1% YoY but net profit fell 1.9% and headcount fell sharply.
